mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a clear 59 degrees out by the Military Ridge State Trail, and we have a beautiful first quarter moon lighting up the sky.
The City of Verona has recently adopted the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan to guide future growth, and the city is currently recruiting for new patrol officers.

It is a busy week in our area. Today, you can catch live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow, the Sugar River Fire and Smoke BBQ Festival begins in Paoli, and the Dane County Farmers' Market is happening on the Square.
Looking at the weekly report, on September 5th, officers encountered a prank where slices of cheese were placed on windshields across several streets in town.
Culver's of Verona is currently closed for a remodel, but they will be opening today at 10 AM to serve you.
